Lindgren's Bakery opened on Harbour Road in 1998. The oven has been replaced twice since then. Greta, our sourdough starter, has not.

We still mix at 3 am, shape every loaf by hand and sell out most days before noon. If you want a dark rye on Saturday, call us on Friday.

default.alt: A baker scoring loaves of sourdough before they go into the oven
